aka.en: Ocean Highway (in the Carolinas and Georgia)
aka.zh: 海洋公路（卡罗来纳两州与佐治亚境内）

tagline.en: The old coast road from Punta Gorda to Virginia, crossing every harbour from Savannah to the York on a bridge that someone had to pay for
tagline.zh: 自蓬塔戈尔达至弗吉尼亚的老海岸公路，从萨凡纳到约克河，每个港湾都要靠一座有人买单的桥跨过

start.en: US 41 at Punta Gorda, Florida, on Charlotte Harbor
start.zh: 佛罗里达州蓬塔戈尔达，夏洛特港畔，与 US 41 相接

end.en: Winchester, Virginia, at the northern end of the Shenandoah Valley
end.zh: 弗吉尼亚州温切斯特，谢南多厄河谷北端

en: US 17 begins inland. From Punta Gorda it runs north through the cattle and citrus country of Arcadia and Wauchula, through Bartow, Winter Haven and Kissimmee, round Orlando and on by Sanford, DeLand and Palatka to Jacksonville, a Florida route that keeps well away from the beaches. Only north of Jacksonville does it become the coast road it is known as, running through Brunswick, Darien and Savannah, the South Carolina Lowcountry and Charleston, Georgetown and Myrtle Beach, and on to Wilmington, New Bern and Elizabeth City.

For most of that distance I-95 runs some way inland and carries the long-distance traffic, so US 17 is the road of the coastal towns themselves. Its character comes from the water it crosses: the marsh rivers of Georgia, Charleston harbour, the Cape Fear, the Albemarle Sound region and, in Virginia, the James and the York at Hampton Roads.

North of the York it turns away from the sea through Gloucester and Tappahannock to Fredericksburg, then north-west across the Piedmont by Warrenton to end at Winchester. Its last miles have nothing to do with the coast at all.
zh: US 17 起于内陆。它从蓬塔戈尔达北上，穿过阿卡迪亚与沃丘拉的养牛与柑橘产区，经巴托、温特黑文与基西米，绕过奥兰多，再经桑福德、德兰与帕拉特卡到杰克逊维尔——这是一条远离海滩的佛罗里达路线。直到杰克逊维尔以北，它才成为人们熟知的那条海岸公路：经不伦瑞克、达里恩与萨凡纳，穿过南卡罗来纳低地与查尔斯顿，经乔治敦与默特尔比奇，再到威尔明顿、新伯尔尼与伊丽莎白城。
这段路程的大部分，I-95 都在更靠内陆的位置承担长途车流，因此 US 17 是沿海城镇自己的道路。它的性格来自它跨过的水：佐治亚的沼泽河流、查尔斯顿港、开普菲尔河、阿尔伯马尔湾一带，以及弗吉尼亚汉普顿锚地的詹姆斯河与约克河。
过了约克河，它离开海岸，经格洛斯特与塔潘诺克到弗雷德里克斯堡，再向西北穿过皮德蒙特高原，经沃伦顿止于温切斯特。最后这几十英里已与海岸毫无关系。

en: US 17 was one of the original routes of 1926. Its history is written in its bridges, because the coast it follows was crossed for decades by ferries, narrow toll bridges and drawbridges. At Charleston the John P. Grace Memorial Bridge opened over the Cooper River in 1929 as a private toll bridge, costing about $6 million; the state bought it in 1943 and took the tolls off in 1946. A second span, the Silas N. Pearman Bridge, was added beside it in 1966 at about $15 million.

At Brunswick, Georgia, the Sidney Lanier Bridge, a lift bridge, opened in 1956 at about $8 million, roughly two-thirds of it federal, and was tolled. In 1972 a freighter struck it and ten people died; it was replaced by a cable-stayed bridge in 2003. In Virginia the George P. Coleman Memorial Bridge, a swing bridge over the York River, opened in 1952 and was tolled until 1976; when it was rebuilt wider in 1995 tolls returned to pay for the work, and they were lifted on 8 August 2025.

The largest replacement came at Charleston, where the Grace and Pearman bridges had become functionally obsolete and the Grace carried a narrow two lanes. The Arthur Ravenel Jr. Bridge, an eight-lane cable-stayed span with a walking and cycling path, opened on 16 July 2005, and both old bridges were taken down.
zh: US 17 是 1926 年的首批路线之一。它的历史写在它的桥上，因为它所沿的海岸几十年来都是靠渡轮、狭窄的收费桥和开合桥渡过的。在查尔斯顿，约翰·P·格雷斯纪念大桥于 1929 年作为私营收费桥跨库珀河通车，造价约 600 万美元；州政府于 1943 年将其买下，1946 年取消收费。1966 年，又在旁边加建了第二座桥——赛拉斯·N·皮尔曼大桥，造价约 1,500 万美元。

在佐治亚州不伦瑞克，西德尼·拉尼尔大桥（一座升降桥）于 1956 年通车，造价约 800 万美元，其中约三分之二为联邦资金，并且收费。1972 年一艘货轮撞上大桥，造成 10 人死亡；2003 年它被一座斜拉桥取代。在弗吉尼亚，跨约克河的平转桥乔治·P·科尔曼纪念大桥于 1952 年通车，收费至 1976 年；1995 年拓宽重建后，为偿付工程费用而恢复收费，直到 2025 年 8 月 8 日才取消。
最大的一次替换发生在查尔斯顿：格雷斯大桥与皮尔曼大桥已经功能落后，格雷斯大桥只有两条窄车道。亚瑟·拉弗内尔二世大桥是一座八车道斜拉桥，附设步行与自行车道，于 2005 年 7 月 16 日通车，两座旧桥随后拆除。

en: The Ravenel Bridge shows how a state now assembles the money for one crossing. Its funding is reported as $325 million from the South Carolina State Infrastructure Bank, $96.6 million from the Federal Highway Administration and a $215 million federal loan, with Charleston County committed to $3 million a year for 25 years; the total is reported at about $700 million. That one bridge cost far more than any figure ever attached to the rest of the route.
zh: 拉弗内尔大桥说明了如今一个州如何为一处过河通道筹钱。据报，其资金包括南卡罗来纳州基础设施银行的 3.25 亿美元、联邦公路管理局的 9,660 万美元和一笔 2.15 亿美元的联邦贷款，查尔斯顿县承诺 25 年内每年出资 300 万美元；总额据报约 7 亿美元。这一座桥的花费，远远超过全线其余部分曾有过的任何数字。

why.en: No figure exists for the route. US 17 was numbered in 1926 over existing state roads, ferries and toll bridges, and has been rebuilt by six states project by project; only individual bridges are costed on their own.
why.zh: 全线并无造价数据。US 17 于 1926 年沿既有州道、渡口与收费桥编号，此后由六个州逐个项目改建；只有单座桥梁留有独立造价。

why.en: There is no single funder. Each state maintains its own section with state and federal-aid money; several of its bridges were first private or state toll bridges.
why.zh: 没有单一出资方。各州以州资金与联邦补助资金养护本州路段；其中几座桥最初是私营或州营收费桥。

label.zh: 亚瑟·拉弗内尔二世大桥（查尔斯顿）

value.en: Reported at about $700 million in total: $325 million State Infrastructure Bank, $96.6 million FHWA, $215 million federal loan, and $3 million a year for 25 years from Charleston County; opened 16 July 2005. Not checked against SCDOT accounts
value.zh: 据报总额约 7 亿美元：州基础设施银行 3.25 亿美元、联邦公路管理局 9,660 万美元、联邦贷款 2.15 亿美元，以及查尔斯顿县 25 年内每年 300 万美元；2005 年 7 月 16 日通车。未与南卡罗来纳州交通部账目核对

figures.source: English Wikipedia, Arthur Ravenel Jr. Bridge, and the sources it cites

value.en: Grace Memorial Bridge, 1929, about $6 million; Pearman Bridge, 1966, about $15 million
value.zh: 格雷斯纪念大桥，1929 年，约 600 万美元；皮尔曼大桥，1966 年，约 1,500 万美元

figures.source: English Wikipedia, John P. Grace Memorial Bridge and Silas N. Pearman Bridge

label.zh: 西德尼·拉尼尔大桥，1956 年

value.en: About $8 million, roughly two-thirds federal; tolled
value.zh: 约 800 万美元，约三分之二为联邦资金；收费

value.en: Reported at about 1,206 miles in English Wikipedia; other tallies give about 1,204. Not checked against state route logs
value.zh: 英文维基百科称约 1,206 英里，其他统计约 1,204 英里。未与各州路线里程表核对

why.en: Six state agencies count their own sections, and the route shares pavement with other routes in several cities. No combined figure is published.
why.zh: 6 个州的机构各自统计本州路段，路线在多座城市又与其他路线共用路面。并无合并数字发布。

timeline.en: US 17 is numbered as one of the original U.S. routes.
timeline.zh: US 17 作为首批美国国道之一编定。

timeline.en: The Grace Memorial Bridge opens over the Cooper River at Charleston as a private toll bridge.
timeline.zh: 格雷斯纪念大桥作为私营收费桥在查尔斯顿跨库珀河通车。

timeline.en: South Carolina, which bought the Grace Bridge in 1943, removes its tolls.
timeline.zh: 1943 年买下格雷斯大桥的南卡罗来纳州取消其收费。

timeline.en: The Coleman Bridge opens over the York River in Virginia.
timeline.zh: 科尔曼大桥在弗吉尼亚跨约克河通车。

timeline.en: The Sidney Lanier Bridge opens at Brunswick, Georgia.
timeline.zh: 西德尼·拉尼尔大桥在佐治亚州不伦瑞克通车。

timeline.en: The Pearman Bridge opens beside the Grace at Charleston.
timeline.zh: 皮尔曼大桥在查尔斯顿格雷斯大桥旁通车。

timeline.en: A freighter strikes the Sidney Lanier Bridge; ten people die.
timeline.zh: 一艘货轮撞上西德尼·拉尼尔大桥，10 人死亡。

timeline.en: The Coleman Bridge is rebuilt wider and tolled again.
timeline.zh: 科尔曼大桥拓宽重建，并恢复收费。

timeline.en: A cable-stayed bridge replaces the Sidney Lanier lift bridge.
timeline.zh: 一座斜拉桥取代西德尼·拉尼尔升降桥。

timeline.en: The Arthur Ravenel Jr. Bridge opens at Charleston on 16 July.
timeline.zh: 7 月 16 日，亚瑟·拉弗内尔二世大桥在查尔斯顿通车。

timeline.en: Tolls on the Coleman Bridge end on 8 August.
timeline.zh: 8 月 8 日，科尔曼大桥停止收费。
